topic: Post-incident review: intermittent 502s on API gateway during peak traffic
key_insights: Most 502s correlated with upstream connection pool exhaustion, not app errors
Retry storms amplified load; client-side exponential backoff reduced error rate
Synthetic checks missed the issue due to low concurrency profiles
consensus_points: Increase gateway upstream keepalive + tune max_conns per upstream
Add peak-load canary + high-concurrency synthetic monitors
Adopt standard client retry policy with jitter
open_questions: Do we need separate pools per critical upstream to prevent noisy-neighbor effects?
final_recommendation: Tune upstream pools and implement jittered retries; add peak-load monitoring and a canary gate before promotions.

topic: Select a vector database for RAG: pgvector vs Pinecone vs Weaviate
key_insights: pgvector simplifies ops but needs careful indexing and vacuum strategy at scale
Managed services reduce toil but introduce vendor lock-in and cost variance
consensus_points: Define target QPS/latency and data retention before choosing a backend
open_questions: What is the expected embedding refresh rate and backfill window?
Do we need hybrid search (BM25 + vector) out of the gate?

topic: Policy design: handling customer data deletion requests across backups
key_insights: Backups are immutable by design; deletion must be enforced at restore time plus retention limits
Audit trail must prove deletion enforcement without retaining personal data
consensus_points: Set maximum backup retention aligned with legal requirements
Implement restore-time scrubbing using a deletion ledger keyed by stable subject IDs
open_questions: How do we handle deletes for derived data (analytics, ML features)?

topic: Roadmap triage: deprecating v1 mobile API without breaking partner apps
key_insights: Partner traffic is concentrated: top 3 partners are 78% of v1 calls
Silent failures come from hard-coded endpoints and pinned TLS ciphers
consensus_points: Run dual-stack for 90 days with proactive partner outreach
Ship server-side compatibility shim for auth header changes
open_questions: Can we offer a temporary allowlist for legacy cipher suites?
final_recommendation: Announce deprecation with a 90-day dual-stack window, monitor partner cohorts, and provide a compatibility shim plus direct outreach to top partners.

topic: Improve onboarding: reduce time-to-first-dashboard for new tenants
key_insights: Most drop-off occurs after SSO setup when users hit unclear schema mapping steps
consensus_points: Add guided checklist and sample dataset for first run
open_questions: Which 3 integrations account for most successful activations?

topic: Security review: rotating service-to-service credentials with minimal downtime
key_insights: Overlapping credential validity prevents deploy coordination bottlenecks
Telemetry must distinguish auth failures from network timeouts to avoid false alarms
consensus_points: Automate rotation via CI with per-service blast radius controls
open_questions: Do any legacy clients lack support for multiple active credentials?
final_recommendation: Implement automated dual-token rotation with overlap and dashboards for auth error attribution; deprecate legacy single-token clients on a fixed schedule.

topic: Pricing experiment design: usage-based add-on for audit log retention
open_questions: What is the baseline retention customers actually use today?
How will we prevent bill shock for high-volume tenants?

topic: Architecture decision: event-driven ingestion pipeline (Kafka) vs batch ETL
key_insights: Kafka helps near-real-time SLAs but increases operational complexity and cost
Batch ETL can meet SLAs if we cap freshness to 15 minutes and handle late data
consensus_points: Choose batch for MVP; revisit streaming when freshness requirements tighten
open_questions: What is the true business value of sub-5-minute freshness?
final_recommendation: Ship batch ETL MVP with late-data handling and 15-minute freshness target; plan a streaming migration only if SLAs require it.

topic: LLM evals: define acceptance tests for a customer support summarizer
key_insights: ROUGE correlates poorly with agent usefulness; prefer task-based scoring and hallucination checks
PII redaction needs separate evaluation from summary quality
consensus_points: Create a golden set with policy labels: factuality, actionability, tone, PII
open_questions: How do we sample edge cases like abusive language and multilingual tickets?

topic: Resolve disagreement: is caching embeddings worth it for low-latency search?
key_insights: Cache hit rate is high for repeated queries but low for long-tail search
Most latency comes from vector DB query, not embedding generation, when using hosted models
consensus_points: Cache embeddings only for deterministic internal queries and autocomplete paths
open_questions: Can we precompute embeddings for top 10k queries without privacy risk?
final_recommendation: Implement a scoped embedding cache for internal/autocomplete flows; focus primary latency work on vector DB indexing and query tuning.

topic: Vendor selection: SOC 2 automation tooling (Vanta vs Drata) for mid-market SaaS
key_insights: Both tools cover core frameworks; difference is connector quality and evidence workflow
Auditor preference mattered less than internal process maturity
consensus_points: Prioritize connector coverage for cloud/IAM and ticketing
Define evidence owners and SLAs before rollout
final_recommendation: Archive: proceed with the tool that best matches connector coverage (IAM, GitHub, Jira) and define evidence ownership before implementation.

topic: New feature decision: should we add per-user API keys for enterprise tenants?
key_insights: Per-user keys improve auditability but raise support burden around key rotation and RBAC
SCIM group mapping can reduce manual access management if enforced consistently
consensus_points: Enterprise customers will expect per-user attribution in audit logs
open_questions: Do we need key scoping by environment (prod/stage) and project?
